title: betula lenta f. uber
intro: Betula lenta f. uber, commonly known as American black cherry, is a deciduous tree species that belongs to the family Betulaceae. The tree is prized for its wood, which is used in furniture-making, and also valued for its medicinal properties. The bark of Betula lenta f. uber contains bioactive constituents such as salicin, which provides health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial actions, as well as therapeutic actions like pain relief and antiseptic properties. The health benefits of Betula lenta f. uber include antioxidant and anti-cancer properties, making it a sought-after natural remedy for various health conditions.
